name: AWS Snowball
overview: AWS Snowball Edge supports offline data transfer and edge computing, but availability is restricted: since November 7, 2025, devices are available only to existing customers, with support in commercial Regions ending December 31, 2026.
examSignals: For current eligible Snowball customers, large offline data transfer can use Snowball Edge; check the published sunset timeline
New customers should evaluate AWS Data Transfer Terminal, DataSync, or partner options according to connectivity and volume

compareWith.diff: Snow Family moves data with physical devices/edge capability; DataSync transfers data online over network.
